description: This file contains configuration code for an Orleans silo, including a silo builder configurator class, an internal interface for a test grain, and a test grain class with a ping method.

classes.name: SiloBuilderConfigurator
classes.description: Configures the Orleans silo builder by adding a distributed grain directory.

classes.name: MyTestGrain
classes.description: A test grain class with a ping method, decorated with a collection age limit attribute.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the ISiloBuilder by adding a distributed grain directory.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: A simple method that returns a default ValueTask, used for testing connectivity.
